name: io.github.WYRE-AI/screenconnect-mcp
title: ScreenConnect
description: MCP server for ConnectWise ScreenConnect RESTful API Manager: session inventory and remote operations.

environmentVariables.name: SCREENCONNECT_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Your ScreenConnect server, e.g. https://<your-org>.screenconnect.com or an on-prem https URL.

environmentVariables.name: SCREENCONNECT_TOOL_TIERS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tiers: read, write, admin. Default read only. Write and admin require explicit opt-in.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'stdio' for local CLI use; the image defaults to 'http' for gateway hosting.

environmentVariables.name: AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Credential source: 'env' reads SCREENCONNECT_* locally; 'gateway' expects X-ScreenConnect-* headers from the WYRE MCP Gateway.

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error
